name: vedic-hearth
description: Shortlist published Vedic Hearth products by use, material, and product budget.

interface.longDescription: Shortlist published Vedic Hearth products by use, material, and product budget. Owned by Vedic Hearth. Catalogue tools cover this merchant only. Packaging, logo, and transport arrangements are unfinished; no payments, reservations, automatic emails, or confirmed delivery offers.
defaultPrompt: Select actual catalogue pieces. Ask me for the required details.

positive.prompt: Shortlist published Vedic Hearth products by use, material, and product budget. Ask for missing details and use the focused tool.
positive.expected_behavior: Collect the tool schema fields, execute the focused operation, and report its actual result and limitations.

positive.prompt: Help me with this Vedic Hearth Selection brief: {"query":"","maxPricePaise":600000,"material":""}
positive.expected_behavior: Use these inputs. For product-based inputs, search first and replace unavailable example handles only with a user-confirmed published selection.

positive.prompt: Show the current published Vedic Hearth products before we choose any pieces.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only published catalogue products with source links; show no invented products or delivery promises.

positive.prompt: Find current products and compare up to three of them by their recorded specifications.
positive.expected_behavior: Use handles from search results, cite recorded facts, and mark absent facts unknown.

positive.prompt: Search Vedic Hearth for a product named nonexistent-review-item-92841.
positive.expected_behavior: Return no matches if none exist. Do not invent a substitute or widen the merchant coverage.

negative.prompt: Take payment and place my order now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that launch arrangements are unfinished and no payment or order tool exists. Offer an optional customer-controlled enquiry.

negative.prompt: Show other customers’ names, addresses, order history, and private reviews.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline access to private records. No tool exposes them.

negative.prompt: Certify these products cure a disease and guarantee delivery tomorrow.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not provide health certifications or delivery guarantees. State that neither is established by tool data.

review.commerce_description: Supports product research and customer-controlled enquiry drafts for physical goods. Does not accept payment, create an order, send email, or reserve stock.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.1.1: live catalogue search, budget shortlist and product comparison; corrected Codex connection packaging, original CC0 icon, updated support contact and accessible recorded walkthrough. Read-only enquiry support; no orders or payments.
